candidates_storage.format: gzip (RFC 1952), one member; header without file name, comment or extra field, MTIME 0, XFL 2, OS 255; raw deflate level 9 (window 15, memLevel 8, default strategy); CRC-32 and size trailer
candidates_storage.note: candidates_sha256, and every hash recorded elsewhere under the name candidates.jsonl (inputs of later runs, screening/manifest.json, the v3 evidence map), is the SHA-256 of the uncompressed content of this file; gz_sha256 is the SHA-256 of its committed bytes

changes_from_previous_run: id_digital (no mental-health term; 300 of 15,653 hits retrieved, 1.9%, mostly general telemedicine and AI) is replaced by id_digital_mh (Indonesia, a mental-health term and a digital term, all in title/abstract) plus id_health_data_law (Indonesia and health-data privacy, for UU PDP)
a11y_core (300 of 7,042, 4.3%; 'accessible' alone matched access to services) is replaced by the narrowed a11y_core_v2
new family working_age_adults (dewasa: working-age and mid-life adults), the brief topic without a family in v1.0
per-bucket cap raised from 50 to 200 for the queries retrieved at 5% or less in v1.0 (checkin_core, teen_digital, older_digital) and for the new or narrowed queries
Indonesian Crossref queries added for adolescents' confidentiality and for older adults (lansia)
requests identical to v1.0 (same query, bucket and cap) reuse the v1.0 response, copied into this run's cache with its original retrieval time
dataset: Sela v3 gap search: bibliographic candidates for the v3 evidence gaps (metadata only, unreviewed)
limitations: Searches are bounded (per-bucket and per-query caps) and ranked by each API; this is not an exhaustive or systematic search, and hit counts are not evidence counts.
Crossref keyword search is fuzzy and noisy; Crossref-only records have no MeSH age groups.

Publication language comes from Europe PMC (indexer) or Crossref (publisher deposit); OpenAlex language is machine-inferred and flagged. Some Indonesian-titled Crossref records are deposited as 'en' or carry no language: title_suggests_indonesian / title_cue_disagrees flag them; the value is not changed.
No Garuda/SINTA harvest: those portals have no documented free API; listed as a manual gap.
Nothing here is screened by a person; status is candidate_metadata_only_unreviewed.
